reel.caption:
₹50 lakh home loan for 20 years: can you guess the interest?

Illustrative at 8.5% a year (current home loan rates run roughly 8–9% at many lenders): EMI ≈ ₹43,391 for 240 months.
Total paid back ≈ ₹1.04 crore, so interest ≈ ₹54 lakh, more than the loan itself.
At an illustrative 8% instead, interest is ≈ ₹50.4 lakh: half a percent is worth about ₹3.8 lakh.
Ask the lender for the total interest, not just the EMI.

Did your guess come close?

Sources: a housing-finance lender's ₹50 lakh EMI worked example (standard EMI formula) and two rate round-ups from October and July 2026.

For education only. Not investment advice.
